rows.completeness_argument: For k<500 adjacent square gaps are at most 999 and cannot skip a complete block. For k=500+t the thousand-block index is 250+t+floor(t²/1000). The first skipped block occurs at t=isqrt(999)=31, before (t+1)² crosses 1000.
With k=ceil sqrt(n) and δ=k²-n, opposite parity is necessary. Then 3δ=5k+8, δ is odd and δ<=2k-2. Thus k>=14 and k=5 mod 6, so the first valid k is 17. Every later square block has larger n.
